modelIdentification.name: pyjevsim-time-advance
modelIdentification.description: Reference FOM for the 3-federate time-advance example. One trivial interaction class (Heartbeat) so all three federates have something to send each cycle; the pedagogical focus is on time-management semantics (LBTS, NER grants, lookahead), not on the payload.

interactionClass.name: Heartbeat
interactionClass.semantics: Per-tick heartbeat from each regulating federate. Carries the federate's own logical time so the runner can verify ordering invariants in the wire log.

parameter.name: now
parameter.semantics: The federate's logical clock at the moment the heartbeat was sent.
